name: Plant Tycoon Fix Patcher
description: Fixes the supported classic Windows Plant Tycoon build: stops the old-age random-death branch and restores sounds and images the LDW release is missing.

settings.name: No old-age plant deaths
settings.description: Stops plants dying of old age. A plant's age starts at 0 when it is created and counts up in the game's internal age units. Once it passes 1720.0, the threshold held as a double at VA 0x4695E0 and compared at VA 0x42E21F, the plant becomes eligible to die: every update from then on calls Random(1000) at VA 0x42E231 and kills the plant when the roll lands in 0-9. That is a 1 in 100 chance, 1%, on each eligible update, and it keeps rolling for the rest of the plant's life, so a long-lived plant faces it repeatedly. Younger plants are never eligible and are unaffected either way. The patch changes one byte, the comparison operand at VA 0x42E23B, from 9 to -1. Because the branch is a signed compare, no roll in 0-999 can fall in range, so the chance becomes exactly 0 rather than merely small. The age check and the random call both still run untouched; only the death branch is now unreachable. Plants still die of neglect, disease and everything else. Touches 1 byte.

settings.name: Add Missing Assets to LDW Version
settings.description: Adds sounds and images the LDW download is missing, taken from the Steam version of the game and bundled with this patcher. The merge is only additive: files are copied into the modded game folder only where the game does not already have them. A game file is never replaced, and a bundled file identical to the game's own is ignored. Turning this off and patching again produces a folder without them. The executable is not changed.

patches.note: VA 0x42E23B, one byte. The old-age branch rolls Random(1000) and kills the plant when the result is 0-9, a 1 percent chance per eligible update. The comparison operand changes from 9 to 0xFF, which as a signed compare leaves the range empty, so every roll 0-999 skips the health-zero write. The age check at VA 0x42E219 and the RNG call itself are untouched.

PE optional-header CheckSum at file 0x150, recomputed for exactly this setting combination (no_old_age_plant_deaths). Windows does not verify this field for user-mode executables, but integrity tools read it, so it is kept correct.
